sa_market_summary: The Chery Tiggo 4 Pro is the breakout automotive success story in South Africa. With over 18,000 units sold in 2025 alone, it became the fourth best-selling passenger vehicle in the entire country. This compact SUV disrupted the market by offering generous standard equipment (twin 10.25-inch screens, wireless Apple CarPlay, keyless entry) at prices starting from R269,900 ,  undercutting Korean and Japanese rivals by R50,000 or more. The 1.5-litre turbo petrol engine (83kW/138Nm CVT or 108kW/210Nm DCT) provides adequate performance. Chery's 5-year/150,000km vehicle warranty and 10-year/1,000,000km engine warranty (first owner only) are headline-grabbing. The refreshed Tiggo Cross LiT launched in 2026 builds on this success.

known_faults.description: The CVT transmission exhibits a noticeable pause when pulling away in Eco mode, followed by a lurch as the CVT catches up. Sport mode sharpens response but causes engine drone. A momentary rollback on hills can also occur.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Test the CVT thoroughly in stop-start traffic at various throttle levels. Try both Eco and Sport modes. Test hill-hold assist on a slope.
known_faults.estimated_repair_zar: R0 (software characteristic); R8,000 - R18,000 (CVT service or replacement if failed)
known_faults.source: Auto.co.za reviews, SA Chery owner community, AutoTrader SA

known_faults.description: The twin 10.25-inch screens can freeze or become unresponsive, particularly in hot weather. Usually resolved by disconnecting the battery or an OTA update.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Boot up the infotainment system and test responsiveness. Check for any blank screens or unresponsive touch areas.
known_faults.estimated_repair_zar: R0 (OTA update or battery reset); R3,000 - R8,000 (screen replacement)
known_faults.source: SA Chery owner reports, Auto.co.za long-term tests

known_faults.description: The wireless charging pad is poorly positioned ,  under hard braking, phones can slide forward under the cupholder and become trapped. A design flaw rather than a mechanical failure.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Test the wireless charging pad with your own phone. Check that the phone stays in place during a test drive.
known_faults.source: Auto.co.za Chery Tiggo 4 Pro review, owner community

known_faults.description: Real-world fuel economy is notably higher than Chery's claimed figures. Claimed 6.8L/100km but local tests consistently show 8.7-9.2L/100km in mixed driving with the CVT, and 7.8-9.0L/100km with the DCT.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Check the trip computer's average fuel reading. Ask the owner about real-world consumption. Budget for higher than expected fuel costs.
known_faults.source: Auto.co.za reviews, SA owner community reports

what_to_inspect_before_buying: Test the CVT or DCT thoroughly in traffic ,  transmission behavior is the biggest common complaint
Check infotainment screens for freezing or unresponsive areas
Verify warranty status ,  5-year/150,000km vehicle, 10-year/1,000,000km engine (FIRST OWNER ONLY)
Check service plan coverage ,  LiT models may have only 3yr/30,000km, higher trims get 5yr/60,000km
Test air conditioning and all climate controls ,  many functions are touchscreen-only
Inspect the wireless charging pad and phone storage location
Check for dashboard rattles ,  common on early models over rough roads
Verify the 10-year engine warranty is still valid (requires dealer servicing by first owner)
owner_sentiment: Mixed to positive. The Tiggo 4 Pro is loved for its incredible value for money ,  buyers cannot believe the level of standard equipment at the price. The warranty is a major drawcard. Main criticisms centre on the CVT's frustrating behaviour in traffic (hesitation and lurching), real-world fuel consumption that is significantly higher than claimed, and the dated dashboard design that is being replaced by the newer Tiggo Cross. Resale value is a concern ,  the model depreciates faster than Korean rivals (approx 11% vs 4% for the Kia Sonet in year one). The 10-year engine warranty does not transfer to second owners, which hurts used values.
